tasks.current-issues-media: Topic: Current-issues media texts. Cover newspaper articles and radio reports, the difference between fact and opinion, making inferences from clues, using evidence, identifying the main idea, and discussing current issues with clear reasons. Ask learners to classify statements, identify bias or viewpoint, match evidence to a claim, or choose the best inference from a short media text.
tasks.fiction-visual-literacy: Topic: Fiction and visual literacy. Cover speculative fiction, advertisements, skimming, scanning, visualising, setting, plot, message, target audience, and vocabulary in context. Ask learners to identify the purpose of an advert, explain how visual clues help meaning, choose the best reading strategy, or answer questions about story setting, plot, theme, and word meaning.
tasks.process-writing-grammar: Topic: Process writing and core grammar. Cover summaries, narrative and descriptive essays, friendly letters, dialogue, the stages of process writing, paragraphing, punctuation, nouns, pronouns, conjunctions, and adverbs. Ask learners to identify the correct text type for a purpose, choose improvements during planning or editing, apply punctuation in dialogue, or answer grammar and sentence-transformation items.
